capabilities: scrape items from webpages into lists
create lists as Markdown tables in notes
preserve user-written status column values on updates
update lists via command palette commands
extras: The README references screenshots that are not included; usage is command-driven and requires enabling per-webpage tracking recipes in settings.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to pull items from webpages into a note and keep a manually maintained status column in sync across list updates.
summary: Webpage-scraping tracker that builds item lists as Markdown tables in notes and lets you track each item's status.
